name: dsh-yi-divination
description: DSH 插件：六爻纳甲与八字四柱的确定性排盘与解读。内置 Python 引擎，装了即用，无需另外 clone 仓库或手敲命令。 / Deterministic I Ching (Liu Yao) & BaZi engine as a DSH plugin — ships its own Python engine so no manual repo checkout is needed.
author: Yi contributors

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run selftest && npm run verify-in-dsh

files.scope: read bundled engine + skills; write temp files under os.tmpdir()/yi-* and %TEMP%/yi-reports for report output; read SKILL.md at load
files.reason: The deterministic engine and skill docs ship inside the package (read-only); generated reports are written only to the OS temp directory, never into user project folders.

commands.scope: spawn the local Python interpreter (DSH-bundled runtime, PATH python, or Windows py launcher) to run the bundled, read-only engine; no shell, no arbitrary command execution
commands.reason: All calendrical/numerological computation runs in the bundled Python engine. The Node half performs no divination math and never execs user-supplied commands.

credentials.scope: read a whitelist of non-secret environment variables only: DSH_HOME, DSH_PYTHON, PATH, PYTHONIOENCODING, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE
credentials.reason: Used solely to locate the Python interpreter and set UTF-8/bytecode env. The plugin never reads secrets, keychains, tokens, API keys, or network credentials, and makes zero outbound network calls.

externalServices.network: none — fully offline; no outbound connections of any kind

failureBounds.pythonMissing: Tools return a clear error listing every interpreter path tried; the plugin never silently falls back to an unknown interpreter.
failureBounds.engineMissing: Startup self-test warns; tool calls error at invocation time rather than producing partial results.
